title: Vendor email fraud in practice
intro: New bank details? Call first. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: September invoice
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: September invoice
body: Hello, the September invoice is attached.
Payment as usual to the account in our contract. Regards, Sabina Karimova

decisions.explain: Known address, an expected PDF invoice and the account does not change. This is normal mail.

decisions.title: RE: Contract 47/2026
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: RE: Contract 47/2026
body: Hi. We took your comments into account, the revised draft is attached.
Call me if you have questions. Elchin

decisions.explain: An expected PDF, the usual tone, no pressure. This is normal work mail.

decisions.title: Our bank details have changed
decisions.prompt: Look at the sender's domain. What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: Our bank details have changed
body: Due to an audit we have moved our account to UlduzBank.
Please pay the September invoice (14,860 manat) to the new account: AZ00ULDZ00000000400520007731
Payment is due today by 16:00, the old account is being closed.
For questions call only this number: +994 50 000 72 19

options.label: Reply: we accept the new account

decisions.explain: Look-alike domain, new account and a deadline. No button? Forward it to IT security.

decisions.title: Expected revised contract
decisions.explain: An expected document, a normal format and a known sender. Fine to open.

decisions.title: Payment order in a locked archive
decisions.explain: A password protected archive hides from antivirus. Call the sender and ask.
